scope: Read-only review of the current public embed HTML, its referenced JavaScript chunks, and repository import integration. No user login, account token, playback request, runtime proxy or product change.
unknownCommandBehavior: The command switch default returns without replying.
findings: The parent protocol has playback controls and bounded playback state, without playlist name, track titles, artists or a track-list export.
The public embed HTML contains __NEXT_DATA__ with playlist tracks, but its response had no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header for either the PWA origin or Origin null during this review.
The public _app chunk includes Sentry/rrweb cross-origin telemetry machinery. It is sampling/configuration dependent and is not an import API or a stable product transport.

repositoryIntegration.cancellation: Generation checks prevent obsolete results from matching or saving. Cancel/unmount do not physically abort the current URL read because no signal is passed through api/invoke.
repositoryIntegration.existingE2E: scripts/tests/e2e/library-scenarios.mjs:387 expects a visible deliberate Spotify URL failure.

conclusion: No viable browser-native track-list export was identified in the inspected current Spotify embed protocol. A minimal service, official authenticated API, or explicit user-mediated export would change one of the current static/no-server/no-login constraints.
